run.name: ATS Corp /ATS
run.title: CP-OS host session (ATS)
run.summary: ATS is moderately levered with strong liquidity and no large debt maturity before December 2028, but earnings are weakening and leverage sits above its target range. Covenant headroom cannot be verified. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context.

revenue.basis: Revenues, as the CP-1 table prints it.

ebitda.basis: EBITDA (non-IFRS), as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Calculated, see C1. Debt is bank indebtedness plus long-term debt, current portion and lease liabilities (the company's own net debt components); EBITDA is trailing twelve month pro forma adjusted EBITDA of 381.3, a company-defined non-IFRS measure. Company prints net 3.1x. Not the credit agreement definition, which is not supplied.

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. Calculated, see C2: pro forma adjusted EBITDA 381.3 divided by trailing twelve month cash interest paid of 91.152 (FY2026 97.501 less six months FY2026 49.648 plus six months FY2027 43.299). Whether cash interest paid includes lease interest is not stated.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Covenant levels, the credit agreement, audited annual notes and ownership detail are not in the pack, so headroom and structural priority are unverified.
CP-1 main limitation: Audited annual notes, the credit agreement and covenant thresholds are not in the pack, so covenant headroom and instrument-level debt carrying values cannot be verified.
